title: Taffeta Silk Anarkali: Fabric Guide and Care Tips
excerpt: What taffeta silk is, why it is perfect for festive Anarkalis, and how to store and care for it so it lasts.
body:
Taffeta silk gives an Anarkali its beautiful structure and soft sheen. Here is what makes it special and how to care for it.

## What is taffeta silk?

Taffeta is a smooth, crisp woven fabric with a gentle shine. Its slight stiffness helps an Anarkali hold its flare and twirl beautifully.

## Why it works for festive wear

- It catches the light, so it looks rich in photos.
- It holds shape, so the flare looks full.
- It pairs well with gota work, sequins and organza dupattas.

## When to wear it

Taffeta Anarkalis are ideal for weddings, sangeet nights, receptions, Diwali and Eid celebrations – especially in cooler months.

## How to care for it

- Dry clean only, especially pieces with gota or sequin work.
- Store on a padded hanger or folded with tissue paper.
- Keep away from direct sunlight to protect the colour.
- Steam lightly instead of pressing a hot iron directly on the fabric.

## Styling tips

Pastel taffeta like lavender or sage looks fresh and modern. Pair it with pearl or kundan earrings and keep other jewellery minimal.
